# BidMart

BidMart is a marketplace auction web application for browsing catalogue listings, bidding on live auctions, managing wallet payments, and tracking orders.

## Links

- [Marketplace](https://bidmart.example/marketplace): Browse active listings and auctions.
- [Wallet](https://bidmart.example/wallet): Manage top-up, withdrawals, and transaction history.
- [Orders](https://bidmart.example/orders): Track auction-won and marketplace orders.
